Map data attribution
GeoNames (https://www.geonames.org/): WGS84 settlement coordinates, CC BY 4.0
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
Selected records retain individual GeoNames links in data/places.js.
Natural Earth (https://www.naturalearthdata.com/): 1:110m countries, public domain.
https://www.naturalearthdata.com/about/terms-of-use/
Stara Goa representative coordinate: UNESCO World Heritage Centre
https://whc.unesco.org/en/list/234/maps/
Coordinates represent approximate settlements, not exact buildings or stratišta.
